title: UI Typography Scale Compiler
description: Verifies typography scale: every step has required fields, min font size, body line height, no negative tracking, i18n font stacks

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract typeface list, scale ratio, platform targets, i18n requirements

pipeline.title: Verify Typography Scale
pipeline.description: Run all gates against typography spec

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed typography artifact for downstream consumers

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: typography-scale-spec.json exists with required fields: steps array

gates.title: Steps Complete
gates.description: Every scale step has font-size, line-height, and font-weight defined

gates.title: Minimum Font Size
gates.description: No scale step has font-size below 12px (0.75rem)

gates.title: Body Line Height
gates.description: Body text step has line-height ≥ 1.4 (WCAG SC 1.4.12)

gates.title: No Negative Tracking
gates.description: Letter-spacing for body text is not negative

gates.title: i18n Font Stacks
gates.description: i18n font stacks defined for every declared non-Latin script

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK in typography spec files

contracts.description: Structural requirements for a valid typography scale

error_codes.UTS002: Scale step missing required property (font-size, line-height, font-weight)
error_codes.UTS004: Body text line height below 1.4 (WCAG SC 1.4.12)
error_codes.UTS005: Letter-spacing is negative for body text step
error_codes.UTS006: i18n font stack missing for declared non-Latin script
error_codes.UTS007: TODO/FIXME/HACK found in typography spec files
